rows.text: We increased our full year 2026 Net Income Attributable to GEO Operations guidance to a range of $168 million to $175 million, or $1.27 to $1.32 per diluted share on annual revenues of $2.95 billion to $3.05 billion and based on an effective tax rate of approximately 30 percent, inclusive of known discrete items.

For the third quarter 2026, we expect Net Income Attributable to GEO Operations to be in a range of $45 million to $48 million, or $0.35 to $0.37 per diluted share, on quarterly revenues of $755 million to $805 million.

For the fourth quarter 2026, we expect Net Income Attributable to GEO Operations to be in a range of $37 million to $41 million, or $0.28 to $0.31 per diluted share, on quarterly revenues of $758 million to $808 million.
